fact: On 27 December 2025 the first fully electronic export contract was executed through the Baldna government data and transactions exchange platform, linking Central Bank of Sudan and Ministry of Trade systems with customs, standards, ports, tax and Zakat bodies.
title: بدء التنفيذ الفعلي لمعاملات الصادر إلكترونياً عبر منصة «بلدنا»
